$description: Navigation sensor health: the optical flow and downward range the flight controller reports, the scanning lidar, and the cameras. The pilot kind carries `sensors` {flow, range, lidar}; GET /api/v1/sensors carries `health` {flow, range, lidar, cameras}. Every surface classifies, labels and colours from this file. color names resolve through tokens.json state.*.

flow.$note: low = OPTICAL_FLOW quality below low_quality for low_hold_ms; lost = no OPTICAL_FLOW for lost_ms after one was seen; absent = never seen.

range.$note: The downward (orientation 25) DISTANCE_SENSOR. out_of_range = current distance outside [min, max] of the same message; lost = none for lost_ms after one was seen.

lidar.$note: rate_hz is the scan arrival rate over the last 2 s. degraded = rate outside [min_hz, max_hz] or driver health warning/error; lost = no scan for lost_ms after one was seen, or the driver reports disconnected; no_returns = scans keep arriving but none for no_returns_ms carried a return (a range above 0.05 m): a blocked window, a failed receiver, a mount facing open sky, or nothing within range. A scan's arrival says the lidar is scanning, never that it sees anything.

nav_imu.$note: plugin.navigation.map_status imu_feed: the FC IMU feeding the lidar planar pose. ok = state ok, or a heading reason (heading_unconfirmed, north_unknown: the lidar map's heading, sent only while the feed itself measures), and rate_hz >= min_hz; a map_status older than stale_ms after a non-null imu_feed is degraded with reason stalled.

warning.flow_degraded: Optical flow quality low: dark or featureless ground

flow.low: Optical flow quality low: dark or featureless ground
flow.absent: No optical flow from the flight controller

rangefinder.absent: No downward rangefinder: height reference is EKF altitude

lidar.degraded: Lidar scan rate or health out of range
lidar.no_returns: Lidar sees nothing: its scans have no returns

nav_imu.ok: Flight controller IMU feeding the lidar pose

readiness.$note: flow and sensor_params are shown when FLOW_TYPE is non-zero or OPTICAL_FLOW has been seen; lidar when a lidar has scanned or the capture service reports one, and otherwise as absent (warn) while obstacle avoidance is on; nav_imu while the latest map_status carries a non-null imu_feed; nav_heading while that map_status is fresh and its imu_feed reason is a heading reason (heading_unconfirmed, north_unknown). Severity: warn, except block in ADOS control mode when the EKF fuses flow (any EK3_SRCn_VELXY = 5) for flow lost/absent and for params with severity block; an expected lidar that is lost blocks in ADOS control mode whatever the avoid setting; a lidar with no returns warns. Where an all-empty scan cannot be open air, in a confined place, or armed while the last surface seen this flight (not the floor, at least 2 m wide, in the same place over 3 scans in a row) must still be in the planar scan (moved less than its 12 m reach less the surface's range less 1 m, and the scan plane at the surface less than 0.5 m up or down: the height change plus the roll or pitch change, judged when the returns stopped, over the distance to it), the pilot does not take an empty scan as obstacle data: the last obstacles stay and, while avoidance is on, age to stale (avoid_state stale: it holds and flies no horizontal motion command; the vertical stick stays live while scans keep arriving); nav_imu and nav_heading block in ADOS control mode while Navigation flies external navigation from the lidar pose (the last nav.state mode is external_nav), and warn otherwise. nav_imu is ok only for imu_feed state ok, or a heading reason, at rate_hz >= min_hz; every other state word (degraded, lost, unknown) reads degraded and appends ' ({reason}, {rate_hz} Hz)', rate one decimal, '--' for a null reason or rate and for a heading reason. nav_heading is never ok: it reads unconfirmed and appends ' ({reason})'.

mount.$note: The declared flow and rangefinder mount, agent config pilot.fc_sensors: flow {pos_m [x,y,z] body FRD metres, orient_yaw_cdeg}, rangefinder {pos_m}. Published as GET /api/v1/sensors health.flow.mount {yaw_cdeg, pos_m} and health.range.mount {pos_m}, null when undeclared.

params.name: FLOW_TYPE
params.reason: MAVLink optical flow (MTF-01P on an FC serial port)

params.name: FLOW_ORIENT_YAW
params.reason: A wrong flow yaw inverts the velocity feedback

params.name: FLOW_POS_X
params.reason: Flow lever arm from the CG

params.name: FLOW_POS_Y
params.reason: Flow lever arm from the CG

params.name: FLOW_POS_Z
params.reason: Flow lever arm from the CG

params.name: RNGFND1_POS_X
params.reason: Rangefinder lever arm from the CG

params.name: RNGFND1_POS_Y
params.reason: Rangefinder lever arm from the CG

params.name: RNGFND1_POS_Z
params.reason: Rangefinder lever arm from the CG

params.name: RNGFND1_MAX
params.reason: MTF-01P range is 12 m at most (8 m in bright light)

params.name: PRX_IGN_GND
params.reason: Proximity ignores ground returns near the floor

params.name: SERIALn_OPTIONS
params.reason: The flow module's port must not forward MAVLink (SERIALn_OPTIONS 1024, or MAVn_OPTIONS 2 on 4.7 and later); the port is not known, so any port passes

params_note: Rows apply only when FLOW_TYPE is non-zero or OPTICAL_FLOW has been seen (FLOW_TYPE itself, RNGFND1_TYPE and RNGFND1_ORIENT always apply then). A row whose parameter is absent from the FC table is skipped. mount rules compare against the declared mount (pos within pos_tolerance_m, yaw exact); without a declaration the else rule applies. group_not_all_zero fails only when every parameter of the group is 0, reported once per group. no_forward_any_port passes when for any n in [1, 9] SERIAL{n}_PROTOCOL is in protocols and SERIAL{n}_OPTIONS has mask set, or MAV{n}_OPTIONS has mask set.
